verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right flow: headline and URL, then the heart-and-hand image, then the CTA. But the image is too small, its hand runs into the CTA/contact text block, the follow-us line sits right on the bottom edge, and a large empty gap sits in the middle. B breaks the key image: the heart and hand are pulled apart, leaving the hand as a meaningless grey blob that collides with the CTA. B also squeezes the CTA and contact copy into narrow, ragged columns with bad wrapping and leaves the URL floating on its own.
